S1 fresh default-source baseline e5bd6aed352aa7da5aba1f1e37fb1aadb2ee6f7c passed on OpenJDK22/sbt1.12.14/Scala3.7.4: embedGrakern + pipeline tasks = 388 passed, 0 failed/errors/skipped. All three declared Git pins were fetched into fresh staging and independently checked against actual build declarations; no override. Existing CLI extraction passed 14 recorded invocations including live network-denial control (online0, sandbox permission-refusal23), both independent readers, paired result/three weights, byte-identical offline replay, exact resume and overwrite refusal. Evidence is under docs/refactor/evidence/source-cli-20261015. Initial disk-full and long-IPC SIGTRAP attempts remain retained.

Prepared S1 implementation: explicit actual-project/update-report origin matching for each packaged JAR; source revision and Maven artifact provenance; complete embedded notice extraction including vendored suffix names; supplemental license evidence bound to exact GAV, artifact SHA-256, declared license, source URL and text hash. Actual runtime has 20 source products and 49 external JARs, all uniquely mapped; 30 lacked embedded text. Catalog covers 49 binaries/51 declarations. Independent helper verified the runtime inventory. Jawn license header comes from its exact Maven sources; all four Standard Webhooks1.1.0 sources match the commit supplying libraries/LICENSE. Python suites passed 13 distribution/notice and 13 qualifier tests. Metabuild compiles; JDK25 formatting and workflow generation passed with no workflow diff. JDK22 formatter failure was independently traced to is-terminal0.1.1 version-22 class being major67; JDK17/21 select its major52 base. No CI matrix change.

The reusable qualifier now performs fresh build, complete runtime proof and actual candidate-POM/direct-root graph inventory. Source installation docs and the bounded ADR0009 provenance amendment are prepared. Next: commit candidate, run reference-scope/full required gate and exact candidate package on the external drive, inspect all totals/POM gaps/notice joins, then independent exact-SHA review and the consumed Atlas seam. This is prepared code plus baseline evidence, not completed S1 or publication. Main remains unchanged; the prior local-main integration approval remains pending. Own-study trust decision is pending user input while S1 proceeds.
